opening: My throat is beginning to swell.
I've suddenly lost the vision in my right eye.
Two days ago I went to an urgent care center, and they thought I had conjunctivitis.

opening.text: I've suddenly lost the vision in my right eye, and my head feels swollen. My throat is beginning to swell, too. Two days ago I went to an urgent care center, and they thought I had conjunctivitis and prescribed me polymyxin. I've been taking prednisone long-term.
